mapper.select: SELECT s.*, m.name as memberName, m.phone as memberPhone FROM member_no_show_stats s LEFT JOIN member m ON s.member_id = m.id WHERE s.member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO member_no_show_stats (member_id, total_reservations, no_show_count, no_show_rate) VALUES (#{memberId}, 1, 0, 0.00) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_reservations = total_reservations + 1, no_show_rate = CASE WHEN (total_reservations + 1) > 0 THEN ROUND(no_show_count / (total_reservations + 1) * 100, 2) ELSE 0.00 END

UPDATE member_no_show_stats SET no_show_count = no_show_count + 1, no_show_rate = CASE WHEN total_reservations > 0 THEN ROUND((no_show_count + 1) / total_reservations * 100, 2) ELSE 0.00 END, last_no_show_time = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
